selections.question_arguments: {"questions":[{"header":"No-client","id":"host_no_client_behavior","question":"While Swift is closed or the Gateway is disconnected, what should the Host continue doing?","options":[{"label":"Sessions, agents, facts (Recommended)","description":"Keep sessions running, admit authorized agent inputs, and record terminal facts/activity independently of attached views."},{"label":"Sessions and agents","description":"Keep sessions running and admit authorized agent inputs; renderer-derived facts resume when a client attaches."},{"label":"Sessions only","description":"Keep shells running; refuse agent integration calls and suspend terminal fact derivation until a client returns."}]}]}

selections.question_arguments: {"questions":[{"header":"Phone route","id":"non_mac_client_route","question":"Should phones and other non-Mac clients connect to a Host without requiring a Mac Gateway to be online?","options":[{"label":"Direct to Host (Recommended)","description":"Each device uses the shared client contract; the Mac app keeps its local Gateway."},{"label":"Through Mac Gateway","description":"Non-Mac devices use a Mac as their relay and depend on it being online."}]}]}
